fields.description: Enter formulas to calculate values or specify which accounts to include
fields.label: Formula or Account Filter

fields.options:
Formula and Account Filter Guide

Use this field to specify which accounts to include or how to calculate values.

Account Selection Examples:
  • ["account.account_category", "in", ["Assets", "Liabilities"]] - Include all Asset and Liability accounts
  • ["account.account_type", "=", "Cash"] - Include only Cash accounts
  • ["account.root_type", "in", ["Asset", "Liability"]] - Include accounts by financial statement category
  • ["account.account_name", "like", "%Revenue%"] - Include accounts with 'Revenue' in the name
Mathematical Calculations:
  • REV100 + REV200 - Add two revenue line items together
  • ASSETS - LIAB - Calculate equity (Assets minus Liabilities)
  • (REV100 + REV200) * 0.1 - Calculate 10% of combined revenue
  • GROSS_PROFIT / REV_TOTAL - Calculate gross profit margin

Important: Use the 'Line Reference' codes from other rows when creating formulas. For Period Movement, the system calculates Debits minus Credits automatically.
